belongs_to_collection.name: Son of the Far Star Collection

data.overview: A boy raised on Earth discovers powers no human should possess and learns that he came from another world. As an adult, he searches for the reason he was sent here, while an approaching catastrophe demands that he become a symbol of hope.
data.title: Son of the Far Star
